title: Nebius and CoreWeave Tout Short-Term Cloud Deals, While AWS Goes Long
summary: While the neoclouds are selling investors on fat margins on quick deals, cloud giant Amazon Web Services had used its earnings call to highlight that it was selling most of its AI capacity via five-year deals.
